title: Don't move Newport Beach to Carpinteria - NewsBreak
text:
By Rosie Blue, Carpinteria ,
5 hours ago The draft Environmental Impact Report (EIR) for the proposed Surfliner Inn analyzes the project largely on its own. But downtown Carpinteria does not operate one project at a time. The Palms renovation includes an event space and a rooftop bar. Linden Square added another one, along with busy restaurants. Both rely heavily on city-provided parking. Now the Surfliner proposal adds yet another rooftop bar and event venue, again drawing from the same limited public parking supply. Read full article

summary: By Rosie Blue, Carpinteria , 5 hours ago The draft Environmental Impact Report (EIR) for the proposed Surfliner Inn analyzes the project largely on its own. But downtown Carpinteria does not operate one project at a time. The Palms renovation includes an event space and a rooftop bar. Linden Square added another one, along with busy restaurants. Now the Surfliner proposal adds yet another rooftop bar and event venue, again drawing from the same limited public parking supply.
